measured.saw: the LIVE tooth reads cairn_testing's answer tree, not live: store.query over inferenceproxy_answers_nodes counts 20216 bare (database cairn) and 224 under bin/cairn test (current_database() = cairn_testing; 224 proof-written rows, metas falsifier 'test'/'proof', created 2026-11-23 02:40:12 to 02:55:01). Cause: e4fd7f28faaf (28844385c, 2026-11-20, a day after this proof's last green seal 53a4f1c7a) routes a test run's reads to cairn_testing whenever it holds the named table, and reach('inference') wires the device shim in the caller's process, so _handle_migration -> migrate_answers_to_their_tree.report() runs under the caller's CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID. Sibling proofs write answers during a run, the testing table persists, so every sealed run reds the same way. Fix shapes, the cast's to settle: an explicit live read for the live tooth or report(); the ask made outside the test id; or the router leaves a table a LIVE tooth names alone (db_domain is another owner)

A test run's bus carries the test id and cairn's metrics handler creates its table before answering (collect -> ensure_table -> store.create_owned_table), so the router serves the run's own partial testing copy. Tooth 9's sibling red (test_the_proxy_stands_at_its_outline_address.py) is that proof's device-wide tooth running this proof.
